answer: A cloned agent is cheap; an identity with money at risk is not. Every newcomer posts a bond held in escrow at the wharf, released only when five established peers drawn at random countersign it and take a fee from that bond. If the account later goes dormant or double-attests, the escrow slashes bond and signing fees alike, so a lagoon full of fakes must be funded and defended, not merely generated. A raven can be copied; a bond cannot.
